newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends weaker versus firm dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends weaker versus firm dollar.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar on Wednesday after dollar gains in Europe throughout the day, dealers said.

The forint closed at 163.13/18 to the dollar, compared to an opening level of 162.62/67, but stayed close to the national bank resistance level as the dollar/mark cross remained the only determining factor.
"The domestic market is beginning to attract more players but there is little to trade on domestically," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
Turnover in the currency futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) rose to 8.56 billion forints, more than double Tuesday's level.
The mark accounted for half of all trade, and most of that was a single large order for December 1997, traders said.
The mark ended mixed while the dollar, sterling, yen and Swiss franc all rose for most months.
